Ein Engel bat für dich auf Erden,: An angel prayed for thee on earth,
bald schwebt er segnend über dir;: soon she shall hover blessing over thee;
'er' grammatically refers to 'der Engel', but semantically refers to Elisabeth hovering as an angel.
Komm, o komm! Zu mir! Zu mir!: Come, o come! To me! To me!
Elisabeth!: The climactic invocation of Elisabeth's name that instantly dispels the Venusberg.
Der Seele Heil, die nun entflohn: Salvation to the soul, which now has fled
Choral blessing for Elisabeth's departed soul; relative pronoun 'die' refers to 'Seele'.
dem Leib der frommen Dulderin!: the body of the pious sufferer!
Dative complement dependent on 'entflohn' ('fled from the body').
Dein Engel fleht für dich an Gottes Thro: Your angel pleads for you at God's throne,
Wolfram reveals to Heinrich that Elisabeth has died and is interceding for him in heaven.
er wird erhört: - Heinrich, du bist erlö: she is heard: - Heinrich, you are redeemed!
Passive construction 'wird erhört' referring to the intercession; 'er' refers grammatically to 'der Engel' (Elisabeth).
Weh! mir verloren!: Venus's final despairing cry as she sinks back into the depths of the Venusberg.
Ihr ward der Engel sel'ger Lohn,: To her was given the angels' blessed reward,
Dative construction: 'Ihr ward' = 'to her was granted'.
Und hörst du den Gesang?: And do you hear the song?
Heilig die Reine, die nun vereint: Holy is the pure one, who now united
göttlicher Schar vor dem Ewigen steht!: stands with the divine host before the Eternal One!
Selig der Sünder, dem sie geweint,: Blessed is the sinner, for whom she wept,
Dativus commodi: 'dem sie geweint' = 'for whose sake she shed tears'.
dem sie des Himmels Heil erfleht!: for whom she implored heaven's salvation!
Prefix 'er-' denotes successful attainment through prayer ('erflehen').
Heilige Elisabeth, bitte für mich!: Tannhäuser's dying words, addressing Elisabeth as an intercessory saint.
Heil! Heil! Der Gnade Wunder Heil!: Hail! Hail! Hail to the miracle of grace!
Triumphant arrival of the Younger Pilgrims bearing the blooming staff.
Redemption has been granted to the world.
Idiom 'zuteil werden' = 'to be bestowed / granted upon'.
Es tat in nächtlich heil'ger Stund': Preparatory 'Es' followed by 'kundtun' ('to make known / proclaim').
der Herr sich durch ein Wunder kund:: the Lord proclaimed Himself through a miracle:
den dürren Stab in Priesters Hand: the withered staff in the priest's hand
Refers to Pope Urban IV's dry wooden pastoral staff.
hat er geschmückt mit frischem Grün:: He has adorned with fresh greenery:
dem Sünder in der Hölle Brand: for the sinner in hell's fire
soll so Erlösung neu erblühn!: The blooming staff symbolizes divine grace overriding human papal judgment.
Ruft ihm es zu durch alle Land',: Proclaim it to him through all lands,
der durch dies Wunder Gnade fand!: who through this miracle found grace!
Hoch über aller Welt ist Gott,: High above all the world is God,
und sein Erbarmen ist kein Spott!: and His mercy is no mockery!
Direct rebuttal to the Pope's assertion that Heinrich's pardon was as impossible as leaves on dry wood.
Der Gnade Heil ward dem Büsser beschiede: Salvation through grace was granted to the penitent,
nun geht er ein in der Seligen Frieden!: now he enters into the peace of the blessed!
